text:
```yaml
name: Kani Verification

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  kani:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Install Kani
        run: cargo install kani

      - name: Run Kani verification
        env:
          KANI_LOG: info
        run: cargo kani test -p storage --features kani
```
